report.root_cause: AuditTrail config (plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml) was changed to debug: true at ~08:10:37, causing the plugin to write ~50MB trace-N.log files under plugins/AuditTrail/debug, filling the disk (23MB to ~231MB of 443MB in about 90s).
report.actions: Noticed disk jump via status, used fs_du to find plugins/AuditTrail/debug trace logs, read the log and config (debug=true), declared incident, set debug: false in config.yml, ran 'audittrail reload' (confirmed debug=false), verified trace files stopped growing, deleted the debug directory, confirmed disk back to 23MB (5%). No restart.
report.residual_risk: Unknown who or what enabled debug; it could be turned on again and refill the disk. No disk-usage alerting or log rotation cap on debug output. The deleted trace logs were not reviewed for content.
